description: Spawns an agent that adds a gameplay tunable to data/balancing/<domain>.json and mirrors it in the schema; the recursive editor form renders it for free.

fields.description: Dotted path into the nested subtree where the new key belongs (place it beside its siblings, not at the root).
fields.label: Key path

fields.description: JSON type of the value and of the schema mirror. Lists are real JSON arrays, never stringified.
fields.label: Value type

fields.description: The value to write into the balancing JSON (typed per Value type).
fields.label: Initial value

fields.description: minimum/maximum for the schema mirror — the editor spinbox reads these so invalid input is unrepresentable (ED-30). Blank = unbounded.
fields.label: Schema bounds (min..max)

fields.description: HP/DMG value: apply the x10 combat scale. (base_hp stays 10 — the documented exception.)
fields.label: Combat stat (x10 scale)

title: Add Balancing Value
